result.title: Nate Herk Breaks Down His 3 Most Powerful AI Automations
result.description:
What if you could automate your video editing, get a panel of AI experts to debate your ideas, and run your social media almost entirely on autopilot?

I sat down with Nate Herk to explore three of his favorite AI workflows that he actually uses every day. He walks me through how he's using Claude Code to automatically edit videos, an AI expert panel called The Roast Room to make better decisions, and an AI social media manager that researches, creates, and publishes Instagram content.

We dive into how he built these workflows, the tools and AI skills behind them, and how you can set them up yourself. Nate also shares how he's using AI to replicate his editing style, automate content creation, and build systems that keep improving over time.
